orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Lok Pal Singh
orders.text:
WPMS 442 of 2019 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
 
 Mr. Aditya Singh, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
 Mr. K.N. Joshi, Deputy Advocate 
General for the State/respondents. 
 Heard. 
 Admit. 
 Counter affidavit be filed within four 
weeks. 
 List thereafter. 
 Having considered the submissions of 
learned counsel for the petitioner, as an 
interim measure, it is directed that the 
recovery issued against the petitioner 
pursuant to impugned order dated 
12.02.2018 shall remain stayed, provided 
the petitioner deposits a sum of 
Rs.10,00,000/- (Ten Lakhs) with the 
authority concerned within a period of four 
weeks from today. (Stay application CLMA 
No.2180 of 2019 is disposed of). 
 
 
(Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
 26.02.2019
Rajni
